questions.text: A’s and B’s salaries are respectively 40% and 70% rupees more than C’s salary. What is the ratio of B’s salary to A’s salary?
While selling 15 balls for ₹1,220, there is loss equal to the cost price of 5 balls. The cost price (in ₹) of one ball is:
If 2% of x = 360, then x is equal to:

A, B, C and D can do a piece of work separately in 30 days, 33 days, 36 days and 44 days, respectively. In how many days can A and B together complete the work, if A and B together are assisted by C and D on alternate two-two days starting with C for first two days, then D on next two days and again C on next two days and so on?
A merchant fixes the marked price of his goods at 50% above the cost price. He sells his goods at 12% discount. His percentage of profit is:
A cube of side 9 cm made of iron is melted and recast into 8 small cubes. Find the side (in cm) of each small cube.
The average age of 28 students of a class is 40 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 41 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:

Ravi decided to cover a distance of 24 km in 2 hours 24 minutes. Further he decided to cover the initial one-third of the total distance at 8 km/hr and the remaining at some different speed. What is the speed (in km/hr) of Ravi after one-third distance is covered?

The students in the three sections A, B and C of Class X are in the ratio 5 : 4 : 7. If 15, 16 and 9 new students are admitted to sections A, B and C, respectively, the ratio changes to 10 : 9 : 11. What is the total number of students in Class X after the new admissions?

Yogesh invested some money in HDFC at 4% per annum rate of interest. What would be the corresponding simple interest (in ₹) if after 2 years, Yogesh got ₹229.5 as compound interest, considering annual compounding?
Rakesh sold 150 chairs and had a gain equal to the selling price of 75 chairs. What is his profit percentage?
12 chairs and 6 tables were bought for ₹12,600. If the average cost of a table is ₹1,500, then find the average cost of a chair.
The population of a district is 327000, out of which 224000 are males. 65% of the population is literate. If 65% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?

Two trains having lengths of 210 m and 440 m are running at speeds of 60 km/h and 90 km/h, respectively, in the same direction. The time taken (in minutes) by the faster train, coming from behind, to completely cross the other train is:

Gopal invests a sum of ₹5400 and Akshay invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 6 years, Akshay gets ₹720 more interest than Gopal, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
